name: Canvas Region
description: Take a region of a canvas to work on: the picture there with room around it, the mask of the part to change, and a stitch that remembers where it came from. The region is a rectangle, the bounds of a mask you connect, or a selection painted in the Canvas view, grown by Padding, and redrawn at the Scale you give, or at a target size in megapixels (as Crop to Mask does, up or down), within the megapixel cap. Padding is raised to Feather + 16 so Canvas Write's blend has room to fade (the node warns). The canvas is read at one revision: head is named once when the workflow is compiled, so a run is repeatable and a re-run of the same revision is a cache hit. Give the stitch to Canvas Write to put the result back as a new layer, or to Stitch.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.label: Canvas
inputs.description: Empty is the Active canvas: the one in the Canvas view you used last, else the newest, named when the workflow is compiled so a run is repeatable. Or a canvas's id, as `fugue canvas new` prints it (canvas-0123456789ab), which pins the node to it. The window picks it from this folder's canvases, or makes one (New canvas, Import picture); a canvas belongs to the Default or the project it was made in.

inputs.name: revision
inputs.label: Revision
inputs.description: head, or a revision's hash (or its first 8 digits or more). head is replaced by the revision it is at when the workflow is compiled.

inputs.name: layer
inputs.label: Layer
inputs.description: Empty reads the canvas as it looks: the visible layers with their opacity, blend modes and layer masks. A layer's name reads that layer alone, its own pixels (the top one of that name; not its opacity, blend or mask).

inputs.name: selection
inputs.label: Selection
inputs.description: A selection painted in the Canvas view (Quick Mask, Use selection), as the canvas folder keeps it: its sha256 hash. With one, it is the part to change and Mask and the rectangle are not used. Empty: the mask, else the rectangle.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The part to change, at the canvas's size or stretched to it. Without one, the rectangle below.

inputs.name: x
inputs.label: X
inputs.description: The rectangle's left edge, in canvas pixels. Not used with a mask.

inputs.name: y
inputs.label: Y
inputs.description: The rectangle's top edge. Not used with a mask.

inputs.name: width
inputs.label: Width
inputs.description: The rectangle's width. 0 runs to the canvas's right edge. Not used with a mask.

inputs.name: height
inputs.label: Height
inputs.description: The rectangle's height. 0 runs to the bottom edge. Not used with a mask.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.label: Padding
inputs.description: Pixels of the canvas kept around the region on each side, so the model sees what surrounds it. At least Feather + 16: Canvas Write's blend stops at the region's box, so less gives a hard edge (a warning says when it was raised).

inputs.name: scale
inputs.label: Scale
inputs.description: The region is redrawn at this multiple of its size (more detail for a small region).

inputs.name: max_megapixels
inputs.label: Cap
inputs.description: The redrawn region is brought down to this many megapixels, its shape kept. 0 has no cap.

inputs.name: target_megapixels
inputs.label: Target size
inputs.description: Redraw the region at about this many megapixels, up or down, its shape kept (Crop to Mask's rule: a small region is brought up to the model's size). 0 uses Scale. The Cap still brings it down.

inputs.name: feather
inputs.label: Feather
inputs.description: How far the mask output softens outward, in canvas pixels: the zone the model may redraw. Canvas Write's Blend is the seam where the result is put back.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.label: Multiple of
inputs.description: Each side of the region is a multiple of this. 16 is the step the diffusion models work in.

outputs.name: image
outputs.label: Image
outputs.description: The region, with its padding, as it is on the canvas (with the canvas's transparency).

outputs.name: canvas
outputs.label: Canvas
outputs.description: The canvas at the revision read: the parent of what Canvas Write adds.
